== Ver. 1.405 ==
-Added on 18 Apr 2022

:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Be not afraid to go to the deepest and darkest levels of dungeons. We fixed critical issue that appeared while one tried to move to the next floor. Enemies and resources awaits!
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] And you know what? Looks like popping achievements are back on the menu, Keepers! We know we took our time with it and some of you might say that it would be faster if the eagles just fixed everything but it's not how it works.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Minor changes in localization.

== Ver. 1.404 ==
-Added on 18 Nov 2021

:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] We talked to parishioners, they will behave well now. No more creepy-standing in the church after a sermon.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Don't be afraid to deconstruct bookshelves - all the stored items will be safe and sound (and fall on the floor).
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Fixed "Axeman" perk - now it affects the number of wood wedges you can get.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] NPC's will now do everything as planned and talk to Keeper as planned, and won't just stay in their houses or on the streets.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Added some changes in localization.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Minor fixes here and there.

== Ver. 1.403 ==
-Added on 10 Nov 2021

:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] We fixed the prioritization of resources for crafting. Now they will be taken directly from Keeper's inventory intstead of bags or trunks or shelves, etc.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Snake and Garry are back on track and ready to talk to you. Sleep safly, the game shouldn't freeze anymore.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Fixed some issues that occurred after extracting souls.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Updated interface for Remote Craft Control. Everything should look and run smoothly now.
:[[File:Update Feature.png|link=|frameless]] Your inventory won't scroll down if you open it while walking upwards.
:[[File:Update Feature.png|link=|frameless]] Polished display of some icons and text in the Technology Tree and crafts.
:[[File:Update Feature.png|link=|frameless]] Updated interface for skullbars of graves, bodies, and zombies. No more skulls out of  borders, everything is in place.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Added some changes in localization.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Even more minor fixes.
:[[File:Update Feature.png|link=|frameless]] We added new Grave Markers and Grave Fences! Bury bodies with even more style.

== Ver. 1.402 ==

:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] No more game freezes after sleep.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Miss Chain is back and ready to talk about the statuette.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Position of the Keeper is now considered while placing objects in the world.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Added some changes in localization.
:[[File:Update Alert.png|link=|frameless]] Minor fixes.
